remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, April 1946" [notes backing inscription 2, but attributes it to O'Keeffe]. Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Note: Yellow calla with green leaves." Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold by Bry, 1973." (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: Yellow Calla

description: Two yellow calla lilies with long green stems and rippling leaves extend from the bottom to the top of this narrow composition. These sit on layers of crinkled white paper or fabric.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
